generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of roadside vehicle breakdown (路边车辆故障). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Set a safe roadside breakdown in a wide lay-by at blue hour, seen from behind and slightly above the disabled car. Its hazard lights glow amber and one front tyre is visibly flat. A person wearing the reflective vest kneels beside, not over, the scissor jack; the wheel brace and portable work light lie clearly apart on a mat. Put the warning triangle farther back in the lane, while one roadside assistance van is parked in the upper background. Coil the jump leads and tow rope separately near the open boot. Dry weather, controlled cinematic light, no crash damage and no dangerous traffic.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: warning triangle, hazard warning lights, reflective safety vest, flat tyre, wheel brace, scissor jack, jump leads, roadside assistance van, tow rope, portable work light.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
